clause_reviews.observation: Only the approved added files and their full contents are within the source-audit proposition. Upstream preservation is owned by G-initial-diff/G-final-scope/G-capture-identity; this panel does not replace gate receipts with component inspection.
Exact API models/signatures inspected. Original minimum-api records are read only as module/caller typecheck evidence; they do not prove iOS14 runtime, linking or visual behavior.
Valid-domain acceptance, caller option order and absence of audio/network ownership inspected in source. No invalid-domain behavior inferred.
Complete ordered fields checked visually per original full-content sweep. Native copy facts remain separate from visual order.

Source declarations inspected; the d1cbcd54 iOS canvas composition cannot be accepted from strings alone and independently fails native identifier exposure. Extra finding A-identifiers records the raw nodes and source cause.
Native enabled/selected/switch facts read independently. Extra finding O-semantics records d1cbcd54 iOS option labels landing on non-button wrappers; inner native buttons carry different labels.
Initial editing visible content is judged at ready, including for the iOS route whose later controls cannot be found by stable ID. Initial pixels do not prove later behavior.
Selection guards and assignment inspected in source. Sampled native selected/enabled rows reviewed; no universal unexecuted selection behavior claimed.
Exact three validation branches inspected in source. d1cbcd54 iOS validation was not dispatched and cannot establish either native behavioral success or failure.

Same-handler started assignment precedes the callback in source. Qualified successful native routes show expected final status and summary; d1cbcd54 iOS Start sequence was unexecuted. No synchronous pixel-render timing inference.
Successful started sweeps preserve caller text and show chosen/acknowledged state and Choose again; enabled/disabled facts remain native. Failed action state remains unknown.
Reset branch has no callback in source. Qualified renewed routes checked; unavailable iOS route does not pass from its initial-looking pixels.

Cancel handler/reset/current ID inspected in source. Sampled qualified Cancel route callback facts checked; repeated Cancel from empty editing and Cancel from started are not independently executed route coverage.
Error-clear and acknowledgement-off paths inspected in source. No unexecuted runtime-path result is asserted.

Full Equatable/hash identity and remember(input) source ownership inspected. Sampled caller update is qualified where dirty prerequisite dispatch succeeded; d1cbcd54 iOS caller update did not exercise dirty replacement.
Unknown from declared component-only source scope: supplied bridge code is not declared evidence for these catalog rows. No bridge conclusions guessed from component intentions.
All explicit role literals and source call sites inspected against typed colors. Native pixels remain mechanical; no manual color override submitted.
Original canvas/primary pixel rows and binding evidence were read. This panel submits only visual atoms and preserves automatic pixel sampling thresholds/results.
Source exact spacing/corner/border/padding composition inspected. AX geometry never used as computed padding proof.
Source platform scaling and font/weight role declarations inspected. No computed font point/pixel measurement inferred from screenshot or AX bounds.

Native rectangle rows retained at strict original thresholds. Several private option-height rows lack fully visible measurements; those stay unknown, with collector coverage findings. Source minimum declarations cannot close those rows or establish physical hit regions.

Readability and wrapping checked in original public and long-content sweeps. Leading alignment audited separately in source. These sampled environments do not by themselves establish every width/text-size combination in the continuous supported domain.
Unknown from declared source scope: review-method separation is an integration/evaluator obligation. This panel itself keeps methods distinct.
Unknown from declared component-only source scope. Raw dispatch prerequisites independently checked for this panel; no action-dependent visual pass granted to an unsuccessful/unattempted sequence.
Each visual atom evaluated independently against its own state and original images; no color, presence, order, wrapping or overlap atom substituted for another.

Qualified route intervals compared to fixed route expectations. Replacement exclusion compares complete logical fields by corresponding option ID; no substring stale-copy oracle used. Unexecuted dirty update remains unknown.
Callbacks are invoked only in valid Start and Cancel branches in declared source, using current caller values. Sampled route success does not prove every unexecuted runtime branch.
